archetype: Periwinkle Mobile App: mobile-first workflows for every role, luminous blue-violet accents, crisp white cards, friendly rounded geometry, and calm institutional clarity

rules: Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato.
Ensure the gap between headings and subheadings does not exceed 2 Tailwind steps.
Body text must use Karla, headings must use Chivo.
Use bold/black weights for institutional authority, balanced with the periwinkle primary and white surfaces.
Use white #FFFFFF for cards and high-contrast content surfaces; never use pure black for backgrounds.
Do not use gradients for primary surfaces, buttons, text, or route identifiers.
Always explicitly set text color on hover.
Use #747BFF (Periwinkle) for primary actions, active navigation, focus rings, and key highlights.
Use #182052 (Midnight Indigo) for headers, institutional navigation, and primary text.
Use #A9B1FF only as a soft supporting accent, never as the primary text color.
Use #51D89A and #FF6B7A only for semantic success and destructive states; they never identify transport routes.
Transport route colors come exclusively from the route palette and remain independent from application states.
Every role uses the same mobile-first app language; desktop layouts expand the app without changing its workflows or interaction model.

surfaces: Student App: Soft rounded corners (16px/xl), periwinkle primary actions, white cards, and tactile but restrained controls.
Admin App: Crisp white surfaces, midnight-indigo navigation, periwinkle active states, 1px lavender borders, and touch-friendly controls that remain comfortable on desktop.
shadows: Student App: Soft ambient shadows (shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(45_54_150_/_0.12)]) for floating cards.
Admin App: Flat white layouts with 1px lavender borders and subtle periwinkle-tinted shadows only on hover.
glassmorphism: For fixed headers/navs: backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/80 with a 1px solid #DDE1FF border at the bottom.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds over content.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Mobile Product Philosophy: use breathable spacing, clear white surfaces, and strong periwinkle focus states. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8).

student_portal.strategy: Mobile-first, stacked white cards over a pale periwinkle canvas. Huge touch targets (min h-12) for PIN entry and attendance confirmation.

admin_app.strategy: Mobile-first administrative app with stacked white surfaces, bottom-sheet or drawer workflows, midnight navigation, and periwinkle active states.
admin_app.widgets: Prioritize one-thumb scanning on mobile; progressively reveal denser summaries, charts, and nominal lists on larger screens.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped (rounded-full) across the entire app, with #747BFF primary fill, minimum h-12 touch targets, and clear primary/secondary hierarchy. Use restrained micro-interactions (active:scale-[0.98], transition-transform).
components.cards: White cards with soft 16px corners, 1px lavender borders, and elevation only when hierarchy requires it; the same language applies to student, operator, and admin flows.
components.inputs: Shadcn standard inputs, customized with our border radius and focus:ring-primary. Use Shadcn InputOTP for the 6-digit PIN.
components.tables: Responsive data views: stacked cards or horizontal scrolling on mobile, expanding into Shadcn Table layouts on larger screens.
components.charts: Shadcn Chart components (recharts) for Dashboard real-time totals.
components.toasts: Sonner (from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx) for post-cutoff correction success, PIN changes, and attendance confirmation.
components.forms: Use Shadcn Form, Select, and DatePicker with label-above-input blocks; use drawers or bottom sheets for mobile CRUD and full-page forms when the task is complex.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Buttons must elevate and increase contrast without changing semantic meaning; active and focus-visible states must also be clear for touch and keyboard users. Table rows must subtly highlight with pale periwinkle.
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific properties (e.g., transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease), NOT transition: all.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Staggered entrance animations for menu items and dashboard widgets.
motion_and_interactions.loading: Skeleton loaders (Shadcn) for real-time dashboard data and menu fetching.

icons.style: Duotone weight for student app, Regular for admin dashboard.

media.rules: No remote stock images or external image URLs in production. Use only reviewed institutional assets committed under frontend/public/assets/ (with documented license) or render the screen without an image. Use max-h-[80vh] for mobile images. Hero image overlays max bg-black/50.

testing.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for text. Provide visual state changes.
testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: You MUST build out a Spanish-language UI ('Portal Web de Comedor SCSC').
Implement a mobile-first app experience for students, operators, and administrators; desktop may expose more density but must preserve the same app workflows.
NEVER use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring tight typography tracking on headings and generous paddings.
Do NOT add .App { text-align: center; } in CSS.
Apply all Shadcn components intelligently. Use InputOTP for the 6-digit PIN login.
Override default component classes if they contradict the Generous Spacing Philosophy.
Include empty/loading/error states explicitly in the UI.
Do NOT output markdown blocks for this JSON file.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Create new components that match the style of existing ones.
Do not use emojis for icons. Use @phosphor-icons/react or lucide-react.
Apply robust data-testid to every button, form input, and key dynamic text field.
